reason: The previous final render-tree patch suppressed the floating global exit button but did not match the visible legacy Active Paper Trade card in production. Replace that exact card directly with one card per open position and a trade-scoped exit button.

required_checks: Direct legacy Active Trade card replacement
Two simultaneous OPEN trades displayed separately
Per-card manual exit sends the pressed trade_id only
Legacy floating EXIT TRADE NOW remains suppressed
validation.root_cause: The V2 ScrollView signature did not match the production Trade tab, while its independent global-overlay suppression still applied.
validation.ui_fix: Install a final V3 wrapper that detects the actual legacy Active Paper/Live Trade card and replaces that component directly, independent of ScrollView structure or minified names.
validation.data_fix: Merge OPEN positions from trade history, trade-live and bot signal payloads, refresh every three seconds, and keep each position's live values separate.

trade_safety: Trade-tab display and explicit user-requested manual exit targeting only. No automatic signal, score, strategy, entry, exit, quantity, stop-loss, cooldown, risk, broker or order rule changes.
